text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――Huh? Where'd I put my training camp 
bottle? I know I refilled it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! Have you seen my bath set 
anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Could that be... a super marvelous 
polka-dot pouch!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
In that case, maybe it was in my bag☆ Or 
maybe it's actually mine—★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, that's what I'm saying! Sheesh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If Marvelous has it, that's fine. All 
right, bus is leaving soon, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Nature, you aren't taking those kids 
with you~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
An origami trophy tucked inside the 
closet☆ Nature's truly marvelous treasure★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, what!? H-How do you know that...!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Every morning and every night, I stared at 
it with a super marvelous, beaming smile☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!! Y-You saw that, didn't you...!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's fine! Just leave that there!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waah, Nature is blushing☆ That look is 
marvelous too★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Enouuuugh already, come on!! Everyone's 
waiting, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —To summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah... It's as hot as ever in here...
choice_data_list: Let's get fired up for the race!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing at all~ I just thought I 
really need to get fired up, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn), and the Arima 
Kinen after that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, every single race is so heavy. 
I feel like I'm getting indigestion.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... if I can really hold my own at 
this camp... maybe, just maybe... I can 
win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Face yourself, and become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Or am I being too shonen-sports-manga 
about this? Maybe the heat's getting to my 
head~

And so, our fiery summer training camp 
with Nice Nature began!
